nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: The core Session service: Effect Schema Info/Patch models plus create/fork/get/list/remove and the message/part update surface (updateMessage, updatePart(s), deltas, findMessage), all persisted through SyncEvent projections rather than direct writes; also defines Session bus events, BusyError, and project/global list generators. Re-exports plan and getUsage.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes go exclusively through sync.run(Event.*) so the V1 projectors and bus stay consistent; reads query SessionTable/PartTable directly via a Database.use helper. Row<->Info mapping keeps snake_case storage isolated from the camelCase domain model.

nodes.name: fromRow
nodes.summary: Converts a snake_case SessionTable row into a Session Info domain object, rebuilding optional summary/share/revert/model structures and branded ModelID/ProviderID values.

nodes.name: toRow
nodes.summary: Converts a Session Info object into a snake_case insert row, flattening summary aggregates, share URL, revert metadata, and time fields onto their storage columns.

nodes.name: listByProject
nodes.summary: Generator that assembles Drizzle where-conditions (workspace, path prefix, directory scope, roots, start time, title search) over SessionTable and yields Info rows ordered by update time with a default limit of 100.

nodes.name: listGlobal
nodes.summary: Cross-project session listing generator with cursor paging and archived filtering that batches project lookups via inArray and joins each row with its ProjectInfo for the global session picker.

nodes.name: BusyError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when an operation targets a session that already has a run in flight, carrying the offending sessionID.

nodes.name: status.ts
nodes.summary: SessionStatus service holding an in-memory per-session idle/busy/retry map in instance state; set() publishes session.status (and legacy session.idle) bus events and clears the entry when returning to idle.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Updates a session's status in the instance map, publishing the session.status bus event always and the deprecated session.idle event on idle transitions, deleting the map entry so idle is the implicit default.

nodes.name: summary.ts
nodes.summary: SessionSummary service computing per-session diff summaries from boundary snapshots, persisting them to storage and the session row, attaching per-message diffs for the summarizer, and lazily unquoting git-escaped paths in cached diffs.

nodes.name: unquoteGitPath
nodes.summary: Decodes git's C-style quoted paths ("\"...\""): octal byte escapes, standard C escapes (n, r, t, b, f, v), and escaped backslashes/quotes, rebuilt through a byte buffer to handle non-ASCII filenames.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Recomputes a session's aggregate diff summary from boundary snapshots, persists it to the session row and session_diff storage, publishes Session.Event.Diff, and attaches fine-grained per-message diffs to the target user message.

nodes.name: system.ts
nodes.summary: System prompt assembly: provider() joins the shared core.txt with a provider-specific delta chosen by matchDelta's model-ID regex cascade (beast/codex/gpt/gemini/claude/trinity/kimi/qwen/glm/deepseek), while the service builds the dynamic <environment> and <skills> sections including semantic skill auto-match.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the shared-core-plus-delta prompt architecture: universal rules live only in core.txt and provider quirks (TodoWrite for Claude, apply_patch for GPT, autonomous mode for o1/o3) in delta-*.txt files matched in a deliberate order.

nodes.name: provider
nodes.summary: Returns the cacheable system prompt prefix for a model: the shared core prompt joined with the provider-specific delta selected by matchDelta.

nodes.name: matchDelta
nodes.summary: Maps a model ID to its provider delta prompt via an ordered regex cascade: anchored gpt-4/o1/o3 (beast) first, then codex before generic gpt, followed by gemini, claude, trinity, kimi, qwen, glm, deepseek, defaulting to the generic delta.

nodes.name: todo-autoclose.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers that auto-complete pending todos when every significant keyword (>3 chars) of the todo content appears in a file diff, preserving the input array reference when nothing changed.

nodes.name: shouldComplete
nodes.summary: Predicate returning true when a todo is still open, has at least one significant word, and all of its words appear (case-insensitively) within a single file change's diff.

nodes.name: applyAutoclose
nodes.summary: Maps autoclose over a todo list, marking matched todos completed; returns the original array reference when no todo changed so callers can skip persistence.

nodes.name: todo.ts
nodes.summary: Todo service persisting per-session todo lists to TodoTable inside a delete-and-reinsert transaction, normalizing legacy status/priority values on read, publishing todo.updated bus events, and applying diff-based autoclose.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Replaces a session's todo set atomically: deletes existing rows and reinserts the new list with positional ordering in one transaction, then publishes the todo.updated bus event.

nodes.name: autoclose
nodes.summary: Applies applyAutoclose to the current todos for a session given recent file changes, persisting via update() only when the reference changed.

nodes.name: usage.ts
nodes.summary: getUsage normalizes AI SDK usage tokens (splitting cache read/write, reasoning, and provider-specific cache metadata from Anthropic/Vertex/Bedrock/Venice) and computes dollar cost with Decimal precision against per-million pricing, including the experimental over-200K rate tier.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses || rather than ?? when falling through cache-write token sources because 0 should also fall through to provider metadata; cost math uses decimal.js to avoid floating-point drift.

nodes.name: getUsage
nodes.summary: Converts a LanguageModelUsage plus provider metadata into normalized token buckets (input net of cache, output net of reasoning, cache read/write) and a Decimal-precise cost using the model's pricing table.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: SessionShare facade over ShareNext: share/unshare a session with config gating, plus a create() wrapper that auto-shares newly created root sessions in the background when the auto-share flag or config is enabled.

nodes.name: share-next.ts
nodes.summary: ShareNext service implementing session sharing: creates/removes shares through the legacy opncd.ai API or the authenticated console API depending on the active account, maintains a per-session in-memory share cache over SessionShareTable, and incrementally syncs session/message/part/diff/model data by watching bus events through a debounced flush queue. Disabled entirely via OPENCODE_DISABLE_SHARE.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses InstanceState so queues and subscriptions are scoped per project instance with finalizer cleanup; the queue is keyed by entity key to dedupe rapid updates before the 1-second delayed flush.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: Queues share data updates for a session keyed by entity (session, message/id, part/...), merging into an existing pending queue or creating one and forking a 1-second delayed flush with error logging.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Drains a session's pending share queue and POSTs it to the sync endpoint with the share secret, logging a warning on HTTP >= 400 without failing the caller.

nodes.name: full
nodes.summary: Performs a full share upload: streams every message and part, resolves distinct user-message models concurrently, fetches the session diff, and queues the complete payload for sync.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a share for a session: POSTs to the create endpoint, upserts the returned id/secret/url into SessionShareTable, caches it in instance state, and forks a full sync with cause-level error logging.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a session's share: DELETEs it remotely with the secret, clears the SessionShareTable row, and drops cached share and pending queue state.

nodes.name: share.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle schema for the session_share table storing the remote share id, secret, and public URL keyed by session with cascade delete.

nodes.name: session_share
nodes.summary: One row per shared session: session_id primary key cascading from session, plus the remote share id, sync secret, and public URL with standard timestamps.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform shell utilities: detects and resolves available shells (pwsh/powershell/git-bash/cmd on Windows, /etc/shells on Unix) with per-shell metadata (login/posix/ps/deny), builds per-shell invocation args that source rc files and cd into the working directory, and kills process trees reliably on both platforms.
nodes.languageNotes: Windows bash resolution walks git.exe up to bin/bash.exe; zsh/bash commands run as login shells sourcing rc files with the cwd passed as a positional arg to avoid quoting issues; killTree uses taskkill /t on Windows and process-group signals with a SIGKILL fallback elsewhere.

nodes.name: killTree
nodes.summary: Terminates a child process and its descendants: taskkill /pid /f /t on Windows, otherwise SIGTERM to the process group escalating to SIGKILL after a 200ms grace when the exited check still reports running.

nodes.name: args
nodes.summary: Builds the argument vector to execute a command in a given shell: nu/fish use -c, zsh and bash run as login shells sourcing their rc files then eval the JSON-quoted command with the cwd as a positional parameter, cmd uses /c, and PowerShell uses -NoProfile -Command.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Engineering notes for the skill subsystem: skill selection is LLM-driven from the system prompt catalog (not algorithmic), semantic auto-match uses a zvec HNSW index with incremental embedding manifests, loaded skills are excluded from auto-match, invalid skills register with warnings but stay hidden from the model, and skill.warning events are log-only rather than TUI toasts.
